title: A flat morphism of finite presentation which is unramified at a point of a field fibre is etale there
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism which is flat and locally of finite presentation and unramified at a point of the fibre over a field becomes etale after shrinking the source to an open subspace containing that point (author lemma at source lines 4547-4564, label lemma-etale-at-point). The proof (source lines 4566-4583) uses the maximal open subspace on which the morphism is etale and its compatibility with base change to reduce to the corresponding criterion for the base-changed morphism (proof lines 4566-4582). The reduction through the maximal etale locus is the substance. H3.
